title: Review publication failure, fresh Post and saved-review retry
description: Requires installed source workspaces and an existing isolated Agent Chrome CDP endpoint. Set PUBLICATION_PROOF_OUT, optionally FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT and PUBLICATION_PROOF_UI_PORT. Seeds completed static reviews in a private farm, creates errors through actual publication RPC and a loopback provider, then uses real browser controls. No worker/model launch, external publication or client-state injection.

publication-recovery.intent: Prove persisted provider errors are visible in both the saved review and real engine gate. Retry the saved review and confirm a fresh Post, then verify the errors clear and exactly one provider review exists per run.
